# Contributing to KrisuAI Pinaka

Thank you for your interest in contributing to KrisuAI Pinaka! We welcome contributions from the community.

## Ways to Contribute

### 1. Report Bugs
- Use the [Bug Report template](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- Include all required information
- Search existing issues first to avoid duplicates

### 2. Suggest Features
- Use the [Feature Request template](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- Explain the use case and benefits
- Be open to discussion and alternatives

### 3. Improve Documentation
- Fix typos, clarify instructions
- Add examples and tutorials
- Translate documentation (coming soon)

### 4. Share Your Experience
- Post in [Show and Tell](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)
- Share test automation success stories
- Help other users in Q&A discussions

### 5. Code Contributions

**Note:** This is a proprietary extension. Code contributions require a Contributor License Agreement (CLA).

Contact us at contribute@krisuai.com before submitting code changes.

## Getting Help

- **Questions:** Use [GitHub Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/discussions/categories/q-a)
- **Bugs:** Create an issue with the bug report template
- **Feature Ideas:** Use the feature request template or Ideas discussion

## Code of Conduct

Please read our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) before contributing.

## License

By contributing, you agree that your contributions will be subject to the project's proprietary license.

---

Thank you for helping make KrisuAI Pinaka better!
